About Ma'anshan Railwheel Industrial Technology Co., Ltd.

A focused railway component supplier supporting professional procurement for wheels, wheelsets, bogies and related rail parts.

Professional rail component supply

Railwheel serves industrial buyers who need dependable railway wheels, wheelsets, bogie parts and running gear components with clear communication and practical documentation.

The company works with project drawings, technical standards, inspection expectations and export requirements so buyers can move from inquiry to quotation with fewer delays.

Brand identity

The Railwheel identity combines a railway wheel, rail track and steel-blue industrial palette to communicate motion, precision and heavy-duty engineering.

  • Blue: trust, engineering and international trade
  • White: clarity and documentation
  • Steel: manufacturing strength and durability
